hazards.evidence: Large throw rug lies in the main walking area with a prominently curled-up corner that could catch a walker or foot.
A black electrical cord runs from the television cabinet across the floor toward the doorway/walking route.
The central walker route is obstructed and narrowed by a footstool, pet bed, toys, and the curled rug.
The room is dimly lit, reducing visibility of floor hazards and obstacles.
A pet bed and several pet toys are scattered underfoot in the central walking area.
